description.value: Haunted Manor is a year-round immersive indoor entertainment venue in downtown Victoria featuring an 18-hole mini-golf course theatrically set inside a haunted manor, with seasonal Halloween and Christmas overlays that bring new storylines, lighting, and set decor. The venue includes private licensed ping pong lounges serving alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages alongside food such as brick-oven pizzas, making it a group-friendly stop for cyclists exploring the city. Reservations are strongly recommended as the venue frequently books out days in advance.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is comprehensive and confirms the business is real, open, and operating at 711 Yates Street, Victoria. Both OSM tags (amenity=bar, leisure=miniature_golf) are reflected on the website — licensed lounge areas plus an 18-hole indoor mini-golf course. The website provides a phone number (778 265 7718) absent from OSM, and the address matches. GF/vegan substitution options are explicitly mentioned on the kids birthday party subpage.
concerns: OSM amenity=bar tag only partially describes this business; it is primarily an indoor mini-golf and ping pong entertainment venue with a licensed lounge component. The leisure=miniature_golf tag more accurately reflects the main offering.
Phone number (778 265 7718) is not present in OSM tags but is confirmed on the website — OSM record should be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible entertainment and licensed bar venue in downtown Victoria — a viable stop for touring cyclists seeking recreation and refreshment.

provenance.category_correction_reason: The venue's primary offering is indoor mini-golf and ping pong entertainment; 'Food & Drink' (matched via amenity=bar) is a partial fit since the licensed lounge areas do serve food and beverages, but the business is more accurately an entertainment/recreation venue with a bar component.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Kids party page explicitly offers vegan pretzel or GF ice cream sandwich (from Cold Comfort) as substitutions for guests with dietary needs; guests with allergies may also bring a custom outside item for that individual
